qualification.details: Design Engineer (Mechanical): B. E/B.Tech (4-year full time course) in Mechanical/Automobile/Production Engineering degree from recognized Universities / Institution / College with minimum 55% marks. Should have done a certified course in CAD/CAE software from any govt. accredited institutions or authorized training centers of software OEMs. Experience: Minimum 2 years of relevant post-qualification industrial experience in Siemens NX, CAE software Simcenter 3D/Ansys, MS Office, and MS Project. Design Engineer (Electrical/Electronics): B.E./B.Tech. (4-year full-time course) in Electrical Engineering/Electrical & Electronics Engineering/Electronics & Communication Engineering/Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering/Instrumentation & Control Engineering with minimum 55% marks. Should have successfully completed a certified course in MATLAB/Simulink, Electrical CAD/EDA, Circuit Design or Electrical System Simulation software. Experience: Minimum two years of working experience in MATLAB/Simulink for modelling, simulation and analysis of electrical, electronic and control systems.

content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the GCF Jabalpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of GCF Jabalpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Gun Carriage Factory, Jabalpur (GCF Jabalpur) for engaging professionals on a fixed tenure contract basis in the defence sector.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 5 vacancies have been announced for the Design Engineer post distributed across Mechanical and Electrical/Electronics disciplines under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GCF Jabalpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the Design Engineer post is 11-10-2026. Candidates should ensure timely submission before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Design Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech degree in Mechanical, Automobile, Production, Electrical, or Electronics Engineering with a minimum of 55% marks along with required certified courses.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 21 and 35 years of age as per the guidelines provided in the official notification of the organization.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month, which is inclusive of all allowances and benefits.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: UR and OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 200/-, while SC, ST, PWD, and female candidates are completely exempted from fee payment.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply exclusively through online mode by visiting the official application portal at https://vacancy.parasnet.com before the final closing date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for GCF Jabalpur Design Engineer?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises eligibility screening, shortlisting for an interview in a 1:5 ratio, a personal interview, and a practical assessment on simulation tools.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the contract engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement is initially for a period of 1 year on a fixed tenure contract basis, which can be further extendable up to a total of 3 years.
